question: As of December 2022, the ‘Kalidas Samman’ award is given in the field of art by the government of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Madhya Pradesh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Kalidas Samman award is given by the government of Madhya Pradesh, for outstanding contributions to the arts
 
• The award was established in 1980-81 to promote excellence in the field of arts.
 
• It is awarded in fields of arts including classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts (painting, sculpture, etc.).
